entries.title: MDP、价值函数与 Bellman 误差
entries.title_en: MDPs, Value Functions, and Bellman Errors
entries.description: 从 Bellman 方程到 MSBE、MSPBE、TD error 与双采样问题。
entries.description_en: Bellman equations, MSBE, MSPBE, sampled TD errors, and double sampling.

entries.title: 概率测度、经验测度与 RL 占据分布
entries.title_en: Probability Measures, Empirical Measures, and RL Occupancy
entries.description: 统一概率核、轨迹分布、平稳分布及折扣占据测度的记号。
entries.description_en: Probability kernels, trajectory laws, stationary distributions, and discounted occupancy measures.

entries.title: 收缩映射、不动点与随机逼近
entries.title_en: Contractions, Fixed Points, and Stochastic Approximation
entries.description: 区分确定性 Bellman 收缩与带噪递推的收敛条件。
entries.description_en: Separate deterministic Bellman contraction from convergence conditions for noisy recursions.

entries.title: On-policy、Off-policy 与经验回放
entries.title_en: On-Policy Sampling, Off-Policy Learning, and Replay
entries.description: 合并完全重复笔记，梳理行为策略、目标策略及数据分布偏移。
entries.description_en: Merge duplicate notes and distinguish behavior policies, target policies, and distribution shift.

entries.title: 策略梯度、REINFORCE 与替代目标
entries.title_en: Policy Gradients, REINFORCE, and Surrogate Objectives
entries.description: 从轨迹似然推导梯度，并解释 baseline、PPO clipping 与 KL 诊断。
entries.description_en: Derive the trajectory gradient and connect baselines, PPO clipping, and KL diagnostics.

entries.title: Eligibility Traces 与 TD(λ)
entries.title_en: Eligibility Traces and TD(λ)
entries.description: 整理前向 λ-return、后向资格迹、在线等价条件和终止边界。
entries.description_en: Forward lambda returns, backward traces, online equivalence conditions, and episode boundaries.

entries.title: 行为克隆、动作分桶与多模态动作
entries.title_en: Behavior Cloning, Action Bins, and Multimodal Actions
entries.description: 从监督损失到闭环分布偏移，比较回归、分类及离散加残差建模。
entries.description_en: Supervised objectives, closed-loop distribution shift, and regression, classification, and residual actions.

entries.title: Diffusion Policy：分布建模与控制时序
entries.title_en: Diffusion Policy: Distribution Modeling and Control Timing
entries.description: 作为已有 P08 的深化笔记，梳理去噪时间、动作块与执行闭环。
entries.description_en: A supplement to P08 on denoising time, action chunks, and the execution loop.

entries.title: 离线 RL 与价值外推误差
entries.title_en: Offline RL and Value Extrapolation Error
entries.description: 解释数据支持域之外的价值估计、max backup 与误差传播。
entries.description_en: Value estimates outside data support, maximization backups, and error propagation.

entries.title: 重参数化与路径导数
entries.title_en: Reparameterization and Pathwise Gradients
entries.description: 推导高斯重参数化、tanh 密度修正和适用边界。
entries.description_en: Gaussian reparameterization, tanh density corrections, and the limits of pathwise differentiation.

entries.title: 最大熵 RL、SAC 与对偶温度调节
entries.title_en: Maximum-Entropy RL, SAC, and Dual Temperature Updates
entries.description: 合并五份笔记，修正温度梯度符号及 off-policy 与 offline 的混淆。
entries.description_en: Merge five notes and correct temperature-gradient signs and the off-policy/offline distinction.

entries.title: Potential-Based Reward Shaping
entries.title_en: Potential-Based Reward Shaping
entries.description: 用望远镜求和解释策略不变性，明确终止状态与奖励尺度的条件。
entries.description_en: Telescoping returns, policy invariance, terminal potentials, and reward-scale caveats.

entries.title: Options、SMDP 与 Intra-option Learning
entries.title_en: Options, SMDPs, and Intra-Option Learning
entries.description: 统一时间抽象、持续时间折扣和跨 option 的样本复用。
entries.description_en: Temporal abstraction, duration-dependent discounting, and experience shared across options.

entries.title: MDP Homomorphism 与状态动作抽象
entries.title_en: MDP Homomorphisms and State–Action Abstraction
entries.description: 区分奖励/转移保持、策略提升、互模拟与近似表示。
entries.description_en: Reward and transition preservation, policy lifting, bisimulation, and approximate representations.

entries.title: Goal-Conditioned RL、UVFA 与 HER
entries.title_en: Goal-Conditioned RL, UVFA, and HER
entries.description: 对齐目标条件价值、事后目标重标记和层次控制接口。
entries.description_en: Goal-conditioned values, hindsight relabeling, and hierarchical-control interfaces.

entries.title: IPPO、COMA 与多智能体梯度方差
entries.title_en: IPPO, COMA, and Multi-Agent Gradient Variance
entries.description: 修正 COMA 拼写，比较独立学习、集中式 critic 与反事实信用分配。
entries.description_en: Independent learning, centralized critics, counterfactual credit, and a bounded variance example.

entries.title: 马尔可夫性、部分观测与 RNN 记忆
entries.title_en: Markov States, Partial Observations, and Recurrent Memory
entries.description: 区分物理状态、观测、历史和 belief，避免将 RNN 隐状态当作充分统计量。
entries.description_en: Separate physical state, observation, history, and belief without assuming RNN sufficiency.

entries.title: Meta-RL：任务分布与快速适应
entries.title_en: Meta-RL: Task Distributions and Rapid Adaptation
entries.description: 梳理基于优化、上下文推断与循环记忆的适应路径。
entries.description_en: Optimization, contextual inference, and recurrent adaptation across tasks.

entries.title: 仿真器、World Model 与规划
entries.title_en: Simulators, World Models, and Planning
entries.description: 说明实验环境、学习动力学模型及内部 rollout 的不同职责。
entries.description_en: Experimental environments, learned dynamics, and internal rollout serve different roles.

entries.title: 具身 RL、LLM/VLA 与研究问题设计
entries.title_en: Embodied RL, LLMs/VLAs, and Research Design
entries.description: 把样本效率、任务适配、奖励和时序问题转为可比较的研究实验。
entries.description_en: Turn sample efficiency, adaptation, rewards, and timing into controlled research questions.

entries.title: TD7 Policy Checkpoints：训练与评估分离
entries.title_en: TD7 Policy Checkpoints: Separating Training and Evaluation
entries.description: 区分候选策略、已部署策略、assessment 与独立 evaluation。
entries.description_en: Candidate and deployed policies, assessment, and independent evaluation.

entries.title: RL 实验统计、置信区间与调参预算
entries.title_en: RL Statistics, Confidence Intervals, and Tuning Budgets
entries.description: 分清随机种子与 episode，整理功效分析、bootstrap、IQM 和调参泄漏。
entries.description_en: Seeds versus episodes, power, bootstrap, IQM, and tuning leakage.

entries.title: 单智能体 RL Benchmark 选型与指标
entries.title_en: Single-Agent RL Benchmarks and Metrics
entries.description: 合并五份调研，按控制、视觉泛化、离线数据及具身任务选择基准。
entries.description_en: Consolidate five reports across control, visual generalization, offline datasets, and embodied tasks.

entries.title: 多智能体 RL Benchmark 与协作评价
entries.title_en: Multi-Agent RL Benchmarks and Cooperative Evaluation
entries.description: 按合作、竞争、混合动机、局部观测及跨伙伴泛化整理 MARL 基准。
entries.description_en: Cooperative, competitive, mixed-motive, partially observed, and cross-partner MARL evaluation.

entries.title: 可复现的 RL 实验与报告协议
entries.title_en: A Reproducible RL Evaluation and Reporting Protocol
entries.description: 统一环境版本、训练预算、checkpoint 选择、独立测试和统计汇总。
entries.description_en: Align environment versions, training budgets, checkpoint selection, held-out testing, and aggregation.

entries.title: 深度策略梯度的理论与实证差距
entries.title_en: A Closer Look at Deep Policy Gradients
entries.description: 梯度估计、价值预测与替代目标景观的实证审查。
entries.description_en: Gradient estimates, value prediction, and surrogate reward landscapes.

entries.title: Deep RL That Matters：补充材料与复现方法
entries.title_en: Deep Reinforcement Learning that Matters: Supplementary Evidence
entries.description: 随机种子、网络结构、奖励尺度和代码实现如何改变算法比较。
entries.description_en: How seeds, architectures, reward scales, and implementations change algorithm comparisons.

entries.title: Era of Experience：经验驱动学习观点
entries.title_en: Era of Experience: Notes on Experience-Driven Learning
entries.description: 区分经验驱动学习范式与 world model 这一模型机制。
entries.description_en: Separate experience-driven learning as a paradigm from world models as a mechanism.

entries.title: GTD2 与 TDC：线性函数逼近下的梯度 TD
entries.title_en: Fast Gradient-Descent Methods for Temporal-Difference Learning with Linear Function Approximation
entries.description: 以 MSPBE 和辅助变量连接 off-policy 稳定性与线性复杂度。
entries.description_en: MSPBE and auxiliary variables connect off-policy stability to linear-time updates.

entries.title: For SALE / TD7：状态动作表征学习
entries.title_en: For SALE: State-Action Representation Learning for Deep Reinforcement Learning
entries.description: 区分 SALE 表征目标、TD7 工程组件及实证结论的适用范围。
entries.description_en: SALE objectives, TD7 engineering components, and the scope of empirical evidence.

entries.title: GAE：优势估计的偏差与方差
entries.title_en: High-Dimensional Continuous Control Using Generalized Advantage Estimation
entries.description: 由 TD 残差构造优势，连接 reward-to-go、λ-return 和 critic 误差。
entries.description_en: TD-residual advantages, reward-to-go, lambda returns, and critic error.

entries.title: 策略梯度定理与兼容函数逼近
entries.title_en: Policy Gradient Methods for Reinforcement Learning with Function Approximation
entries.description: 明确占据分布、兼容特征和函数逼近的理论条件。
entries.description_en: Occupancy distributions, compatible features, and theoretical assumptions for approximation.

entries.title: Potential-Based Shaping 与 Q 值初始化等价
entries.title_en: Potential-Based Shaping and Q-Value Initialization are Equivalent
entries.description: 通过 Q 值平移解释奖励塑形与初始化的路径等价条件。
entries.description_en: A Q-value shift explains conditional path equivalence between shaping and initialization.

entries.title: Sutton & Barto：强化学习教材阅读路线
entries.title_en: Reinforcement Learning: An Introduction — A Reading Route
entries.description: 从表格方法、函数逼近到探索与近似策略梯度的章节路线。
entries.description_en: A chapter route from tabular methods through approximation, exploration, and policy gradients.
